mechanism: Establish one clearly adult original subject and a fixed dark spatial axis before material typography appears. Assign each module one short original word, one material family and one physical behavior. Keep the subject identity and travel direction continuous while material physics change. Compress prior modules through a bounded aperture, ribbon or paper relay rather than random cuts. Converge all material channels into one stable terminal portrait and readable original title. The reusable mechanism is the ordered baseline, trigger, continuity, controlled escalation and terminal proof—not the source identities, brands, wording, locations, props, exact styling, choreography, camera path, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one clearly adult original subject and a fixed dark spatial axis before material typography appears.
invariants.purpose: Makes the baseline measurable before the mechanism changes it.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without the baseline, later change has no trustworthy reference state.

invariants.rule: Assign each module one short original word, one material family and one physical behavior.
invariants.purpose: Binds the first visible change to a specific cause rather than decoration.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a visible trigger, the transition reads as an arbitrary edit.

invariants.rule: Keep the subject identity and travel direction continuous while material physics change.
invariants.purpose: Preserves identity, material or spatial continuity through the middle transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without continuity, the sequence becomes unrelated montage or identity drift.

invariants.rule: Compress prior modules through a bounded aperture, ribbon or paper relay rather than random cuts.
invariants.purpose: Raises intensity or information while retaining the same readable grammar.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without controlled escalation, the middle either plateaus or turns into noise.

invariants.rule: Converge all material channels into one stable terminal portrait and readable original title.
invariants.purpose: Provides a terminal proof that resolves the mechanism instead of merely stopping.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without terminal proof, the promised result or reversal remains unverified.

slots.name: camera_grammar

slots.name: sound_family
